items.title: Department of Energy (Chris Wright) on Williams Companies (Constitution Pipeline) (WMB): Government stake/deal
items.content_text:

Source: https://www.energy.gov/articles/energy-department-advances-constitution-pipeline-project-42-million-defense-production-act
